operator_source: 6 September 2026 clarification and supplied ROADMAP v2 excerpt
design_hypothesis: Scientific questions relate to broader areas through parent and cross-links; an idea may contribute by resolving evidenced uncertainty in any relevant context.

distinctions.context: Scientific landscape, unresolved questions, assumptions, sources and relationships; descriptive, not an experimental prescription.
distinctions.charter: Chosen objectives, scope and evaluation criteria; informal discussion does not require a new charter.
distinctions.scientific_blocker: Unresolved scientific question or assumption with supporting sources, last checked date and observable evidence of progress.
distinctions.operational_dependency: Access, authentication, server, resource or permission dependency; tracked separately from scientific merit.

stages.action: Inventory existing context index, librarian, grounding, charter, human controls and lifecycle. Assess the smallest intake and linked-context extension; demonstrate prediction plus an explicitly human-origin suggestion.
Assess contribution, validity, information gain, uncertainty, resources, assumption-challenging ideas, non-prescriptive context and human usability.

stages.artifact: bounded shared intake/context adapter and tests
stages.action: Preserve human origin, prior work, successor questions and task/source versions through debate, critique, revision, feasibility and experimental review. No automatic adoption.

constraints: No automatic score for keywords, parent linkage or consensus blocker proximity.
Scoring or charter changes are explicit proposals, not ratified by this task.
Retain existing campaign limits, frozen evidence and all named authority gates.
Verify specific philosophical attributions before using them; no named framework is required.
Supplied roadmap status and philosophical claims are historical assertions, not current verification or new permissions.
Later remote-server authorization supersedes the historical roadmap's no-server preference.
No complete context architecture prerequisite for P001 or other eligible scientific desk work.
execution_requirements: Metadata/document-only system author/review using existing subscriptions; no patient access or new provisioning.
migration_status: Pending explicit task-amendment route; do not mutate the existing three immutable server task bindings. Include this linked task in the next migrated queue/report update.
suggestion_provenance: Use an actual operator-supplied suggestion with attribution; do not invent a human-origin scientific idea.
